meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 读懂 git diff 或 PR 的改动：对照知识图谱列出直接改动和受影响组件、涉及的层级与风险，并生成 diff overlay 文件供仪表盘查看。
howto.when: 分析 git diff 或 pull request、弄清改了什么和风险时使用。需先有 .understand-anything 下的知识图谱，否则提示先运行 /understand。

say.text: 看一下我当前未提交的改动有什么风险
say.note: 会先读知识图谱，再给出改动与风险分析

say.text: 分析一下 main...HEAD 上的改动影响哪些组件
say.note: 输出受影响组件与涉及的层级

say.text: 帮我分析 PR #123 的改动
say.note: 分析该 PR 的改动与风险，并写入 diff overlay

howto.what_en: Analyzes git diffs or PRs against .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json to list directly changed and affected components, touched layers and risks, then writes a diff overlay file.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to analyze a git diff or pull request to see what changed and what is at risk. Requires .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json; if missing it tells you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Look at the risks in my uncommitted changes
say_en.note: Reads the graph, then reports changes and risks

say_en.text: Which components do my main...HEAD changes affect?

say_en.note: Writes a diff overlay for the dashboard
